verdict.rationale: Evidence for this story is indirect. The Platform CLI docs list webhooks among the trigger types for building integrations, and a community user says Zapier made it 'very easy to implement a webhook'. Neither documents a user-exposed custom catch URL that starts a Zap run with the request payload. Missing for 10: first-party docs on a custom webhook trigger URL, details on payload parsing and mapping into the workflow run, and hands-on corroboration of the webhook-to-run flow.
